errors.error_description: The case statement for the FSM has no default and omits handling for state S_HOLD, creating an unhandled transition path.
Within a sequential always_ff block, sel_pipe is assigned using a blocking '=' while other registers use non-blocking '<=', creating a race hazard.
The combinational mux logic uses an incomplete if-else chain for y_comb without a final else or default assignment, inferring a latch in synthesis.
